items.html: And from these phases the body of ZA was made, and they clothed the NHY of Arich as mentioned above; and likewise the vessels, sparks, and lights of the kings were selected for the sake of GAR of ZA, in the secret of vessels, membranes, and Mochin, and GAR of ZA were made as above. And these clothed the lower third of Tifferet of Arich, and the matter is that it has been explained above that Tifferet is called Vav, and likewise Yesod is called Vav.
